u0: Idle shop state: no client order is currently being handled and the siren is silent. Next objective: keep a lookout — if a client arrives, begin service by taking the order; if the siren starts ringing, go to the switch and turn it off.
u1: A client is waiting at the counter and the order has not been taken yet; the siren is silent. Next objective: face the client and toggle to take the order, then head to the pantry for food.
u2: The client's order is taken but the agent is not carrying food — it may have not fetched any yet or dropped/slipped it. Next objective: pick up a portion from the pantry to start holding food; if food falls, pick it up on the very next move.
u3: The agent is carrying raw food for the waiting, ordered client. Next objective: carry it to the stove and toggle there to prepare it, keeping the food secure from slips.
u4: The agent carries prepared food and the client's order is still outstanding. Next objective: go to the client and toggle to serve the order and complete the cycle.
u5: Auxiliary order/service state with a client involved; progress through taking the order, holding food and preparing/serving continues from here. Next objective: take the available order if not yet taken, otherwise proceed with fetching or preparing food toward serving.
u6: The siren is ringing and must be silenced before other work continues. Next objective: walk to the siren switch, face it, and toggle to turn the siren off, then resume any pending client service.
